newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VASTNED OFFICES/IND., RETAIL DETAIL 1996 STOCK DIV.
newsitem.headline: VASTNED OFFICES/IND., RETAIL DETAIL 1996 STOCK DIV.

text.p: Property fund VastNed Retail said on Wednesday it had set its 1996 optional dividend at two guilders plus one new share per 17 held.
In March, it announced it would pay a 1996 cash dividend of 8.05 guilders, up from 7.85 in 1995, or an optional dividend consisting of a cash part and a payment in new shares.

VastNed Offices/Industrial said it would pay an optional dividend of 2.40 guilders in cash plus one new share per 28 in hand. It said in March it would pay a cash dividend of 4.80 guilders, compared with 4.67 in 1995, or an optional cash plus stock dividend.
